title: Settings
description: Your language, appearance and privacy preferences, saved in this browser.

language.title: Language
language.description: The interface language. Records keep the language they were entered in.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Light, dark, or follow your operating system.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: With your consent, HuiTong records which pages and features are used, never what you type or who you are.
privacy.gpc: Your browser sends Global Privacy Control, so analytics stays off whatever you choose here.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animations follow your operating system’s reduced-motion setting.
motion.reduced: Reduced motion is on: animations are replaced by still states.
motion.full: Reduced motion is off: animations play briefly and only where they help.
